svg.title: Prompting guides outputs without weight updates
svg.desc: A prompt contains an instruction, optional examples, and a query; prompting does not update model parameters. Chain-of-thought elicits steps, self-consistency samples and votes, and prompt sensitivity measures answer changes across intent-preserving paraphrases alongside accuracy.

g.text: Prompting guides outputs without weight updates
Chain-of-thought and voting can help; paraphrase sensitivity measures robustness.
Hard prompts can be brittle to wording.
